mechanism_narrative: The consistent four-week upward trend in RETAIL_REC mobility, from -22.4% to -13.3%, indicates strong underlying momentum for continued recovery, driving further increases over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in WORKPLACES mobility, crossing the -10% threshold from baseline, signifies a critical mass of people returning to offices, which will directly boost local retail and recreation activity within two weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -10% but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the subsequent 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of decreasing RESIDENTIAL mobility (less time at home) and increasing PARKS mobility (more outdoor activity) indicates a broader shift towards out-of-home engagement, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL decreases and PARKS increases, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Assuming an easing of public health restrictions, the observed broad recovery across TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and RETAIL_REC mobility will continue, leading to further increases in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as people resume pre-pandemic routines.
failure_condition: If restrictions are confirmed to be easing, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent four-week decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility, from 9.0% to 5.1%, indicates a persistent behavioral shift away from home-centric activities, directly translating to increased out-of-home engagement and higher RETAIL_REC within one week.

mechanism_narrative: The significant and sustained increase in PARKS mobility, especially crossing the 0% baseline, signals the onset of more favorable weather conditions, which will encourage general outdoor activity and consequently boost RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility rises above 0% from baseline
failure_condition: PARKS mobility remains above 0% for two consecutive weeks, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the subsequent 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent recovery in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility suggests a rapid return to daily commuting patterns, which will directly increase incidental retail and recreation visits during transit and work breaks, boosting RETAIL_REC within one week.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'reopening' regime, the observed four-week recovery of RETAIL_REC from deeply negative values (-22.4% to -13.3%) demonstrates strong pent-up demand and a clear trajectory towards further normalization, driving continued increases over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the region is confirmed to be in a 'reopening' regime, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.
